source_refs.note: 2. Empirical Formula: a main subheading of 19.5 Representing Organic Molecules, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 45-45.

blocks.text: The formula which represents the smallest whole number ratio of atoms of each element present in a molecule of a compound is called empirical formula. For example, empirical formula of butane (C₄H₁₀) is C₂H₅, and for ethanoic acid (acetic acid, C₂H₄O₂) is CH₂O.
